title: How Google DeepMind is researching the next Frontier of AI for Gemini — Raia Hadsell, VP of Research
talk_summary: Raia Hadsell surveys DeepMind's non-LLM research: omnimodal Gemini embeddings with Matryoshka representation learning, GraphCast/GenCast/FGN weather models, and Genie 3 interactive world models. It is a research overview with no engineering practices for agent orchestration, review, or cost control.

takeaways.what_they_do: Train one embedding network whose vectors can be truncated to fewer dimensions for cheap retrieval, then expanded for more expressiveness, instead of maintaining separate models.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you could start out doing a retrieval using only 256 dimensions for your embedding and then you can expand that to get to more expressiveness
takeaways.numbers: 256-dim base; up to 8K tokens, 128s video, 80s audio per vector

takeaways.technique: Single unified multimodal embedding per artifact
takeaways.what_they_do: Encode text, video, audio, and PDF into one vector end-to-end rather than stitching per-modality pipelines, avoiding information loss at combination steps.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you don't have to have different steps to try to bring you can be truly end-to-end and not lose information
